source: Five stored 2026-09-20 calibration loopbacks; resource correlation onset minus actualRenderFrame
tiePolicy: nearest slot; exact slot-distance tie goes to earlier slot; candidate collision tie goes to earlier time then source order
boundaryPolicy: half adjacent slot interval, inclusive at equality; never shift an extra note to its second-nearest slot
missingActualFrame: unknown inside saved range makes anchor unavailable; demonstrably future unsubmitted rows are unrecorded; never substitute requestedCaptureFrame for h
interruptedRecording: slots at/after saved PCM end are unrecorded, excluded from missing-note denominator; retain plannedTotalSlots and unrecordedSlots
nonzeroPcmFirstFrame: unsupported until coordinate mapping is established; anchor unavailable
limitations: K has not been measured on this v2 engine.
Raw r2/knee/rho timing is not validated physical onset.
Monitoring route can change the audible self-signal delay.
One-period timing errors can cross reference-band boundaries.
Near-half-interval deviations have ambiguous note correspondence.
slotPlanPolicy: No implicit 32 default. Task slots define an explicit plannedNoteCount (1..256) on new practice requests and saved run plans; retain legacy explicit run/task frame mappings. Only actualRenderFrame determines h; guided 16-step version may use explicit practiceClickCount=16.
